name: notion
description: Notion integration — search workspace content, read pages and blocks, query databases, and create or update pages via the Notion REST API.
author: Buildersoft LLC

fields.label: Internal Integration Token
fields.helpText: Create an internal integration and share pages/databases with it

tools.name: notion.search
tools.description: Search pages and databases shared with the integration. Optionally filter to only pages or only databases.

query.description: Text to search titles for. Omit to list everything shared with the integration.

filterType.description: Restrict results to only pages or only databases

tools.name: notion.get_page
tools.description: Retrieve a page's properties and metadata by id.

pageId.description: The page id (with or without dashes)

tools.name: notion.get_block_children
tools.description: List the child blocks (content) of a page or block.

blockId.description: The parent page or block id

tools.name: notion.query_database
tools.description: Query a database's rows, with optional Notion filter and sorts objects.

filter.description: A Notion filter object (see Notion API docs)

sorts.description: A Notion sorts array (see Notion API docs)

tools.name: notion.create_page
tools.description: Create a new page under a database or a parent page. Provide either parentDatabaseId or parentPageId. For a database parent, either pass a raw properties object or a title (which builds a minimal Name title property).

parentDatabaseId.description: Create the page as a row in this database

parentPageId.description: Create the page as a subpage of this page

title.description: Convenience title. Builds a minimal Name title property (database parent) or the page title (page parent).

properties.description: Raw Notion properties object. Overrides title. Required if the database's title property is not named 'Name'.

children.description: Optional array of Notion block objects for initial page content

tools.name: notion.update_page
tools.description: Update a page's properties, or archive/unarchive it.

properties.description: Raw Notion properties object to set

archived.description: Set true to archive (move to trash), false to restore

tools.name: notion.append_blocks
tools.description: Append content blocks to the end of a page or block.

blockId.description: The parent page or block id to append to

children.description: Array of Notion block objects to append
